summary: This bill authorizes the Secretary of Agriculture to implement emergency watershed protection measures on National Forest System land through agreements with sponsors like state governments and Indian Tribes, providing funding and waiving matching requirements for these projects aimed at addressing natural disaster impacts and restoring forest health.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes an emergency forest watershed program to address natural disasters and occurrences on National Forest System land, focusing on runoff retardation, soil-erosion prevention, flood mitigation, and maintaining/restoring forest health. These measures are explicitly aimed at protecting natural resources and water resources, which directly aligns with environmental protection.

The bill authorizes a new emergency watershed protection program on National Forest lands, including federal payments to sponsors with waived matching requirements, which would increase federal outlays without any identified offsets or revenue measures.
